stage1.impression: A view down a tunnel of smooth, evenly lit oak planes toward a small, distant room where two red-glowing speakers flank a floating sculpture of multicoloured neon rings and a featureless seated mannequin. The brightest things in the frame are the blank oak soffit and door leaf in the foreground, not the place you are meant to want to enter, and at 1:1 the oak reads as clean CG veneer with streaky smearing, with no terrazzo, bar, glasses or atmosphere to make it a lived-in night room. A design magazine would not run this as a specific, well-made place: it reads as an architectural walkthrough still of a generic timber corridor, not a photograph of a bar.

blocking_9: The destination (the Tropos pair, Mother EARF, the room) must be the brightest, most legible part of the frame; today the foreground soffit (median 191) and left door leaf (median 111) are 2.5-5x brighter than the room (median 38).
The frame needs a context the brief asks for: the bar (quartzite top, terrazzo, glasses, people at the bar) in the foreground, not 60% of the frame filled by two blank oak planes.
Frame lum_median must sit in 22-50 (now 61.1) with pools of light and dark between them rather than an evenly washed porch.
The oak must read as oiled oak at 1:1: ray fleck, pores, slight sheen variation and darker end grain at edges, not a smooth veneer with vertical denoiser streaks.
People must read as people (motion-blurred, clothed, in a believable pose), not a grey mannequin.
Visible atmosphere in the lantern so the speaker and Mother spots show as falling-off pools.

defects.what: Porch soffit/lintel face overexposed and flat (median 191, p95 225, 0.37% clipped), with vertical streaky smear that reads as denoiser or a stretched texture; it is the brightest surface in the frame and pulls the eye away from the room.
Left door leaf evenly lit (median 111) smooth flat-sawn veneer; grain reads as a printed texture at an enlarged scale, no pores, no edge wear.
Right slotted oak face: slats identical, perfectly regular, no tone variation between boards; reads as procedural.
The amber band at the top is cut off by the frame edge and reads as an orange corrugated strip, not lit acrylic fins; no glowing edges visible.
Seated figure is a featureless grey mannequin with no motion blur (it is static), reading as a placeholder dummy.
Mother EARF's saturated blue, green, yellow and red rings break the one-colour rule and read as a CG gyroscope (product, see out_of_scope).
Left Tropos clipping 2.96% in its lit acrylic; region median 41 (below 45 target).
Right Tropos clipping 3.55%; median 49, barely legible as a hero at this size.
Lantern floor and porch floor flat and featureless (range 46), no terrazzo chip or end-grain read, no props.
No haze visible; spot cones inside the lantern have no falloff in air; the room reads clean like a showroom.
No signs of life in the foreground: no glass, record, coat or bar edge; the brief's 'people at the bar' are absent.

changes.problem: The porch soffit and lintel face are the brightest thing in the frame and wash out the destination.

evidence.measured: lum_median 191.4, p95 224.8, clip 0.37%, versus lantern interior [355,360,735,800] median 38.0

change.to: 0.15 W/m2, and aim it to graze the slotted face below the band only, not the porch soffit

changes.expected: Soffit drops to a warm mid-tone with the graze raking the slots; the eye goes through the porch to the room.

changes.problem: The room inside the lantern is darker than its porch, so the pair and Mother read as a dim postage stamp.

evidence.measured: back wall median 81; speakers medians 41.3 and 49.4; interior [355,360,735,800] median 38

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spots and Mother EARF spot
change.from: pair 2 x 70.0 W 34 deg; Mother 45.0 W 26 deg
change.to: pair 2 x 120 W at 26 deg aimed at the speaker faces (not the back wall); Mother 70 W at 20 deg; trap 0.2 -> 0.12 W/m2 so the back wall falls off between the pools

changes.expected: Both Tropos read as the hero with lit faces and glowing acrylic, back wall darker between them, a clear pool on each speaker.

changes.problem: The left door leaf is lit as evenly as a showroom panel and competes with the room.

evidence.measured: lum_median 110.6, p5 55.9: no shadow anywhere on a 2 m leaf

change.setting: the route (area, 2700 K) and the fill (area, 2900 K)
change.to: route 0.03 W/m2; fill 0.02 W/m2; let the counter spots' spill be the only light on the leaf, falling off top to bottom

changes.expected: The door leaf goes to a dark warm frame with a soft gradient, framing the lit room.

changes.problem: Two blank oak planes fill about 60% of the frame and the bar, people and terrazzo the card asks for are not in it.

evidence.measured: left leaf + soffit + right face occupy x 0-355 and 735-1140 plus y 0-360; room opening is about 300 x 300 px

change.to: pull back about 3 m along the bar (x about 6.6), seated eye height 1.15-1.2 m, offset so the quartzite counter edge, a glass and a bar stool run in the lower-left foreground; 35 mm; target at the porch opening (z about 1.6) with shift, not tilt, to keep verticals; f/2.8 so the foreground glass softens

changes.expected: The porch becomes a lit doorway at the end of a lived-in bar; the band reads whole; the room stays legible through two door pairs.

changes.problem: The frame is too bright overall for a night interior once the hierarchy is fixed.

change.to: 3.5 (after c1-c3), keep AgX Medium High Contrast

changes.expected: Frame median in the 35-48 range, shadows holding detail, practicals not blown.

changes.problem: The oak reads as smooth CG veneer with vertical streaks rather than oiled oak.

evidence.measured: visible vertical smearing at 2x crop; slats on [770,40,1140,800] identical in tone

change.to: quarter-sawn oiled oak with ray fleck and open pores in a bump map at real scale (pores under 0.5 mm), roughness 0.45-0.6 varied per board, per-slat random tone offset of plus or minus 6% value; darker end grain at slat ends; reduce denoiser strength or raise samples to 512 on the soffit area to remove streaks

changes.expected: Boards read individually; the oak shows grain and sheen like a photograph.

changes.problem: No atmosphere: spots inside the lantern have no visible beam or falloff.

evidence.measured: interior lum_range 117 with no gradient in air; floor [435,650,700,800] range 46.5

change.to: 0.015 per meter inside the lantern only (keep the bar room at 0.006)

changes.expected: Faint cones on the pair and Mother, a soft glow around the band, depth between the two door pairs.

changes.problem: The seated figure is an unblurred grey mannequin and the frame has no sign of life.

evidence.measured: uniform grey figure, no motion streak despite shutter 0.8

change.to: clothed scanned figures with a moving head or arm so shutter 0.8 blurs them; one person at the bar in foreground; a glass and a record sleeve on the counter; a sleeve out on the lantern's side table

changes.expected: The room reads inhabited; no figure reads as a placeholder.

out_of_scope.request: Replace or desaturate Mother EARF's multicoloured neon rings, which break the one-colour rule and read as CG.
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF is an EARF product as placed and fixed by the card; only her spot can change.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Tropos acrylic thicker-looking or change its Ember tint so it reads more clearly as cast acrylic rather than red glowing boxes.
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' shape, colour and parts may not be changed.

out_of_scope.request: Make the amber band's fins visibly thick with glowing polished edges.
out_of_scope.why: The band's place and fins are fixed; only its glow can change, and the camera change c4 should bring it into frame.
